sm_top.sm: Multiple tankers were struck in the Strait of Hormuz and the US struck an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island.
A gas tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire and injuring or leaving crew members missing.
Ukrainian strikes damaged the Crimean Bridge, halting rail traffic and leading Russia to halt ceasefire negotiations.
Houthi forces launched an attack striking a financial tower in central Riyadh.
The U.S. military returned to having two aircraft carriers stationed in the Middle East.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed senior Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis.
Iranian missile and drone attacks on the U.S. Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait, causing fires, damage to hangars, and killing six service members with eleven injured.
Houthi forces seized control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait area following the withdrawal of Yemeni government forces.
Israel concluded a tank raid and ground operation in Gaza to demolish a Hamas tunnel.
Iran launched a drone attack targeting a US military radar system in Bahrain.
The International Court of Justice ruled Myanmar guilty of genocide against the Rohingya.
Houthi forces are advancing toward Aden, prompting Yemeni government forces to reinforce defensive positions in the surrounding areas.
Poland detained suspects in connection with sabotage and terrorist preparation plots.
Saudi-backed forces launched a major attack on Houthi rebels in Yemen.
Russian attacks across Ukraine killed 4 people and injured 36, following overnight launches of missiles and drones.
Hungarian rail services to Ukraine are suspended due to safety risks from Russian drone strikes.
Russian missile and drone strikes hit infrastructure in Kyiv, causing power outages and casualties.
The aircraft carrier USS George Washington departed the Middle East to return to the Pacific.
Israel carried out airstrikes targeting an underground missile site and weapons shipment in eastern Lebanon's Beqaa Valley.
Iranian Army Air Defence claims to have shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
A Houthi missile struck Riyadh's financial centre, damaging the tallest building and the Saudi wealth‑fund tower, with no casualties.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes across Yemen continue, with reports of at least 11 civilians killed.
Russian strikes and drone attacks on Odesa resulted in casualties and property damage.
Dutch and Austrian embassies in Kyiv were damaged in a projectile strike.
The Yemeni army reported carrying out over 700 operations against Houthi forces, neutralizing fighters.
Russian air defenses intercepted over 1,300 Ukrainian drones during a major large-scale aerial attack across multiple regions.
Ukraine's Air Force reports air defenses intercepted Russian drones overnight.
Russia launched a massive ballistic missile strike on Kyiv, causing powerful explosions across the capital.
Blasts were reported in Sanaa, Yemen.
Israel carried out a tank raid beyond the Yellow Line in Gaza, extending its ground operation.
Ukrainian air defense downed 69 of 98 enemy drones launched in an overnight attack.
Amnesty International reports that Rapid Support Forces drone strikes in El Obeid may constitute war crimes.
Ukrainian long-range drones struck a major petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, Russia.
UN reported that drones caused most civilian deaths in Sudan in 2026.
Russia attacked Ukraine with missiles and drones.
A Russian military An-12 transport aircraft crashed in Siberia, resulting in the death of all 19 people on board.
The US military carried out self-defense airstrikes on an Iranian missile launch site.
A Russian strike on Dnipro damaged the Austrian consulate building and killed two people.
The Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of killing nearly 20 people in an attack on a vessel in Yemen.
Russian drones target Kyiv while strikes hit the Kharkiv region and Tatarstan.
